infobox.usage: Unlocks a door to the eastern staircase on the second floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stair landing key (Stairs) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the one of the stair landings of the Chekannaya Street 15 building.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the eastern staircase on the second floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building at Streets of Tarkov. Only accessible via the western staircase from the third floor through a hole in the floor of cell #5. The debris in the second floor hallway can only be passed by proning.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: No loot, but the ability to jump onto the stair landing that connects the second with the first floor, or straight down to the first floor.
